dependencies.rationale: Closed-asset scarcity and no-forgery depend on Elements native-asset conservation.
Receipt, entitlement, and control issuance are pinned through issuance introspection.
Explicit-arithmetic and public-delta seams read explicit consensus values.
Owner signatures must commit all outputs; ANYONECANPAY remains a separate input-set policy.
The maturity-cycle CPFP anchor depends on package selection.
Tagged destruction outputs must not remain in the current UTXO set.
Emitted script must enforce STATE/RESV and control/vault welds represented by the model.
L-BTC settlement is provided by the Liquid functionary consortium.
The compiler must emit script matching the typed transition model.
Blind lateral movements discharge conservation through consensus CT balancing.
Amount-blind relabel discharges per-object preservation by commitment equality.
Reveal-at-spend paths, if implemented, authenticate openings on-chain.

rationale: A root would not make the unbounded fold self-verifying.
A shared root would serialize the burn hot path.
Full-chain verifiers recompute attestation from public history.
Ordinary users may trust their Layer-1 system.
Historical residue explains conservative recorded supply.
No monetary, interface, covenant, or consumer formula reads residue.
Admission must not possess payout-affecting aggregation discretion.
Integer floor allocation is not additive across merged requests.
Lost owner keys must not retain shared distribution state.
Settlement outputs are owner-preserving and formula-bound.
Maturity conversion occurs in the cycle reaching the maturity cycle index.
No announced-but-unconverted limbo state is permitted.
The cap does not limit cumulative historical deposit volume.
The cap is enforced at genesis, admission, cycle, and invariant validation.
The pool never holds more active L-BTC backing plus admitted escrow than the maximum L-BTC supply.

amount_limits.rationale: Maximum simultaneous settled reserve plus admitted deposit escrow.
